records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Media set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Cedar Media* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, already hit first_project and sent 1 invite, and Wei replied positively (email:b7694acc) saying things are "good so far" — real but passive engagement, no tickets, no stated blocker. Pro plan suggests intent. Still no key_milestone with 8 days left, and Wei deflected further help, so roughly even odds, slightly below.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Cedar Media's setup
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for the update — glad things are going smoothly so far, and good to hear the invite went out.

One thing that tends to help teams early on: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting your real work mapped into that structure is usually where Wrenfield starts paying off. If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 20-minute call this week and help you set up your first real project and tasks together.

Either way, I'll stay out of your inbox unless you need me.

Best,
Chidi
